title: Flagstaff, AZ — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Flagstaff, AZ: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Flagstaff is a city in AZ with a population of 76,000. Mountain town at 7,000 feet with skiing, hiking, and Lowell Observatory under dark skies. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 266 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 26.0.
